deviations.decision: Themed 404 with the site chrome, keeping Framer's copy ("Page not found" / "This page doesn’t exist or has moved." / "Back to home"). Suppresses the 404's Layout and Type Gaps, including the Header and Footer the Reference lacks; its copy, links, media hosts and status are still checked. Approved in #46.
Per-page titles, descriptions and OG images (#13) instead of Framer's one title for every page. The snapshot records only the title, so this suppresses title Gaps. Approved in #46.

deviations.anchor: Retention quickly emerged as one of the platform’s biggest challenges. Many users treated Acacia as a one-off utility: once they switched plans or completed an upgrade, there was little reason to return. For the business to grow sustainably, we needed to create ongoing value that encouraged regular re-engagement. The opportunity was to position Acacia as an independent partner in every user's renewable energy transition — always in the their corner, delivering insights that optimise their finances while helping them do their part for the world at large.
deviations.decision: The Reference's "always in the their corner" typo is fixed to "always in their corner". Approved in #46.

Reduced-motion support: under prefers-reduced-motion the Build's videos don't autoplay, where Framer ignores the setting. Snapshots are taken under reduced motion, so this suppresses video-autoplay Gaps. Approved in #46.
The header theme toggle at every width. It sits beside "Let's talk" and moves it, so this suppresses that run's position Gap in the Header. Approved in #46.

En dashes in date ranges (’23 – ’25, 2025 – Present) where the Reference uses hyphens. Suppresses punctuation Gaps on the Reference's date ranges only; a case change on them is still a Gap. Approved in #46.
The footer shows the current year instead of Framer's fixed 2025. Approved in #46.
